BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adoptionrelated advertising; and amending RCW26.33.410.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 26.33.410 and 1989 c 255 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in RCW 26.33.400 applies to any radio or television stationor any publisher, printer, or distributor of any newspaper, magazine,billboard, or other advertising medium which accepts advertising andattempts to verify compliance with RCW 26.33.400 in good faith withoutknowledge of its violation of any provision of RCW 26.33.400.
